data = scene_data(selectors=['N02','N04','N05'])
print(type(data).__name__)
print(data.keys())
for key,value in data.items():
 print(key, type(value).__name__, (list(value.keys()) if isinstance(value,dict) else len(value) if isinstance(value,(list,tuple)) else str(value)[:400]))

witnesses=[('N02/N04','N02',[0.3933072752061826,0.03778198904093692,0.4368741434974505]),('N02/N04','N04',[0.3899999884128096,0.13700000196695328,0.4368741434974505]),('N02/N05','N02',[0.42765141914091725,0.034424301227470804,0.43834713347889087]),('N02/N05','N05',[0.49000000953674316,0.18500000331550837,0.7949999924749136])]
print('source',data['source_ref'], 'domain',data['source']['source_index_domain'])
for pair,name,point in witnesses:
 obj=next(obj for obj in data['objects'] if obj['name']==name)
 vertices=np.asarray(obj['vertices']); triangles=np.asarray(obj['triangles']); point=np.asarray(point)
 matches=[]
 for triangle_index,indices in enumerate(triangles):
  corners=vertices[indices]
  basis=np.column_stack((corners[1]-corners[0],corners[2]-corners[0]))
  weights=np.linalg.lstsq(basis,point-corners[0],rcond=None)[0]
  bary=np.array([1-weights.sum(),*weights])
  residual=np.linalg.norm(corners.T@bary-point)
  if residual<1e-12 and bary.min()>=-1e-12:
   matches.append({'triangle_index':triangle_index,'vertex_indices':indices.tolist(),'barycentric':bary.tolist(),'residual_m':float(residual)})
 print(pair,name,matches)
